notes.title: Halloween Release - DomSim v 2.0
notes.notes:
After two hard years of squeezing sexy game development in around real-life responsibilities, we are proud to bring you the [i]Early Access[/i] release of our [b]Full Game Play Loop.[/b] 

This release showcases the intent of Dominatrix Simulator as a game that gives players license to explore their kinks with their favorite Mistresses and triples the available content.

We can't think of a better way to celebrate this release than by dressing up our Mistresses for our [i][b]favorite spooky holiday[/b][/i] [i](costumes in game until Nov 10)[/i]!

[h2]How the Full Loop Works[/h2]

After completing the tutorial, players can choose the Mistress they want to visit and enter her "Hub". In the hub, you will be greeted and asked why you are visiting her.

Depending on how you answer, a task, punishment, or reward scene will begin. When you complete a task, you will be given either a punishment or reward based on your performance. You should always have to pay off punishments before you can receive a reward, but if you're not ready to be punished, you can still do a task.

[h2]Placeholder Content[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33725826/ade131dd553f81b390f06f3cc92da180a86eb9d3.jpg[/img]

All of the content previously available only to Patrons is now included, as well as placeholder scenes for unfinished content.

Placeholder content includes temporary rooms, placeholder silhouettes for Mistresses, subtitles in place of dialog, and the ability to answer yes / no to simulate how you performed in a scene. These are in place to demonstrate how the full gameplay loop works and that the underlying code is working the way it should.

[h2]New Scenes[/h2]

A series of new repeatable scenes have been introduced, allowing you to truly experience what it feels like to be trained to perform, rewarded for doing a good job, and punished for displeasing a Mistress. Several of these scenes get progressively harder as you play them, truly challenging how well you can obey!

- Headmistress - Hand Signal Training (high protocol)
- Mistress Nega-Yuki - Reward Edging (humiliation, foot worship) & Teasing (crotch worship)
- Mistress Yuki-Onna - Puppy Play Training, Spanking, Milking (pet play)

[h2]Save/Load[/h2]

To continue your progress between play sessions and keep those Obsidians and Bloodstones you have yet to spend, your game will now automatically save. There are profile slots in the journal if you want to start a new game from scratch. (Look for the bookmark with the 'save' icon on it.)

This is a new system, so be sure to let us know if you find any quirks with it!

[h2]Preview New Mistresses[/h2]

And finally, all nine Mistresses for the full game are represented here in their various states of completion and you'll find hints as to what the Mistresses yet to be released might be like.

notes.title: Delaying Full Release
notes.notes:
Last month, we were premature in announcing that we were ready to go to Full Release on Steam - the point at which a game exits Early Release and is re-launched on the store as a complete product.

We actually wrote about this in our last post titled 'Happy Valentine's Day!!', but thought we needed to be a little more clear what's going on.

As we always do, we [i][b]listened to our fans[/b][/i] who asked for [b]more content[/b], [b]better replayable options[/b], and [b]how to know more clearly when the 'experience' is over[/b].

[h3]What is available in the store today:[/h3]
The current build is a stand-alone experience that introduces you to the Goddess, three other Mistresses, and ends with the player having a second encounter with the Goddess. The gameplay is linear and guides you through how to interact with the characters, respond to commands, and use punishment and reward tokens.

[h3]What we are adding while the game is still in Early Access:[/h3]
We are expanding on this build to add in a forced sex reward scene with Mistress Nega Yuki (a scene previously ONLY available to Patrons) and we are adding an alternate ending with the Headmistress that has never been seen before. Players will soon have the choice to spend their reward with Mistress Nega or decline and redeem it with the Headmistress instead. The final encounter with the Goddess will also change depending on the choice you make.

We are also adding in an emotion system for the Mistress's expressions and improved animations.

[h3]When we will leave Early Access:[/h3]
The Threshold 'experience' will stay in Early Access until we are satisfied that the content is complete, polished, and provides players with the experience they have been looking forward to.

[h3]Why we've decided to release future content as separate titles/modules/releases:[/h3]
As a small dev team of two working part-time around full-time jobs and family, we have dedicated the last 18 months to building a solid foundation for an entire new game world, which is showcased in this standalone polished, game 'experience'. 

We want to create more!! More content, more story, and more Mistresses! 

To do this, we had to make the hard choice to start generating more funding support than what we could achieve through Patreon alone. 

By choosing to break our larger vision of a full game into complete, stand-alone experiences that will eventually be hooked up together into an integrated game and released on Steam, we are taking a risk with our fans and the larger Steam community. It's a risk that we hope you'll support us in taking as we release polished content for you to enjoy while also generating the funding necessary for one of us to begin working on the DomSim world full-time.

We know this is an unconventional approach and we have to ensure that what we release in this 'experience' and future experiences is worth your time and money!

[b]And if you're ever unsatisfied, please, please, please take full advantage of Steam's refund policy!![/b]

[h3]How you can help.[/h3]
If you love what we are making and want to help, then we can use your assistance! Here are a few ways you can do that:
[olist]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/953270]Post a review![/url] Let people know what you love about it! This will help others find is and try it and help us spread the word.
[*][url=https://discord.deviant.tech]Join in on the discussion on Discord![/url] Let us know what you think, share your ideas, and discuss the endless possibilities with us.
[*][url=https://patreon.deviant.tech]Support us on Patreon![/url] Get access to preview and playtest builds and follow along with more detailed development posts.
[/olist]

notes.title: Release Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33725826/9f98d8dd0d5cbc69996cc9fd3f59849a79edacd3.png[/img][h1]Hello Patrons and Fans!![/h1]

We're excited to bring more content to you in just a couple weeks! On Dec 15, patrons will get early access to the[i][b] “Learning the Ropes” [/b][/i]content we've been working on the last couple of months.

[url=https://www.patreon.com/deviantdev]Patrons [/url]will get a [i][b]special code phrase[/b][/i] in a patrons-only post to unlock content for the first 30 days. It will then be free for everyone on Jan 15, 2019. 

As our sincerest appreciation for all that our patrons have done for us and the game, patrons will always get new content first, but do keep in mind this means early access content that has some parts with placeholder assets or missing interactions.

[h1]New Mistresses and Rooms[/h1]

We're introducing the concepts for three new Mistresses with this release: the Headmistress (more on her in the next post), Yuki-Onna, and Nega-Yuki. The Headmistress is a [b]complete, custom model paid for by Patreon funds[/b]. Yuki and Nega are placeholder models for now, but will also be replaced with custom models you’ve funded as well.

Each Mistress has her own room that she plays with you in. These rooms are placeholders for now. We've commissioned two of these rooms to be custom for our game, but they aren't ready yet.

[h1]Introductory Scenes[/h1]

Every time we put a new Mistress in the game, you'll get to play through a special 'introductory' scene with her. These are story and character-driven scenes separate from the submission scenes that make up normal gameplay. You'll play through three of these: one for each of our new Mistresses.

[h1]Punishments and Rewards[/h1]

In addition to meeting each of our three new Mistresses via their intro scene, you'll be introduced to our punishment and reward gameplay system. Depending on how you perform tasks (coming in the next release), you will be given punishments or rewards for your performance. 

For this release, we guide you through this process the first time, but in the future, you will be able to choose the Mistress you want to pay off a punishment or earn a reward through.

[h1]Early Access Content vs. Polished Content[/h1]
[b]
Early Access Content [/b]includes:
- placeholder models
- placeholder rooms
- subtitles
- placeholder game mechanics via the in-game menu
- some player poses (but many will require the in-game book-menu, at first)
- static character poses with transitions (smooth animations come later)
- some sound effects
- placeholder music

Because it takes time to build this much content and polish it, as we continue to do with the introduction to our [b]Goddess[/b], please rest assured we will be working towards polished content over the next month.

[b]Polished Content [/b]includes:
- Voice over
- Animations
- Full pose support
- New game mechanics
- Full sound effects

[h1]Being Part of Game Development[/h1]

One of the major reasons we have taken this approach to release early access content is because [i][b]we are still learning what fans and players like[/b][/i]. We could spend a year building content and polishing the hell out of it, but if it's no fun to play, then we've just wasted all that time and money!!

So, we are releasing content as we create it so we can get [b]YOUR [/b]feedback about what actually works and what doesn't. We need to know if the characters are sexy, the story is compelling, the scenes turn you on, and whatever else you think makes or breaks this game!

We hope you will all welcome this approach as a chance to shape a new kind of gameplay. We couldn't do this without you!!

Thank you!

Deviant Dev and Devilish Domina

notes.title: Release 0.6.2.3 - Lip Sync and Dynamic Eye Movement
notes.notes:
Several weeks ago, we sat down and planned out some short term content goals for the game. We set a target date of[b] Dec 15[/b] to release a number of new things, including enhancing existing content. More on our short term goals and a formal announcement of what we are releasing will come in the next few days!

One of the user stories we set up was this:

[b][i]As a player,
I want the characters to be more lifelike
So they feel like they are really in the room with me.[/i]

Acceptance Criteria:
When I interact with the Goddess, her eyes meet mine and they move realistically.

When the Goddess speaks with me, her lips move in sync with what she is saying.
[/b]

In fact, we’ve actually had this goal all along, but as mentioned in our last post, we are slowly adding layers of improvements over time. This particular improvement jumped our list of features in large part from the consistent feedback from fans and reviewers checking out the game.

Deviant did a bunch of research on different programs and decided to go with [url=https://lipsync.rogodigital.com/]LipSync Pro by Rogo Digital[/url]. He chose this tool because it supports both blend shapes and bone animations, and has a lot of extra support for gestures and emotions. 

Eventually, we’d like to investigate [url=https://developer.oculus.com/documentation/audiosdk/latest/concepts/audio-ovrlipsync-sample/]Oculus Lipsync for Unity[/url], because it provides real-time lip sync, which will make it easy for players to use when we release moddable tools, but not as much customization. We decided to go for the more robust tool for our own content, but will be looking to make it easy for you to mod in the future, should you want to create your own custom fantasies!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33725826/2b5b016abd42f09c178e0b71230d77f44625184e.jpg[/img] 

We are hard at work on our next module,[b] Dominatrix Simulator: [i]Learning the Ropes[/i][/b], and on making improvements to D[b]ominatrix Simulator: [i]Threshold![/i] [/b]

Two things worth saying a little about right now is how we are iterating the game’s development and what we have been doing to accelerate content development.

[b]Iterating Game Development - Our Approach[/b]

We are building the game in modules so that we can roll out self-contained scenes faster than would normally happen in the game development life cycle. Each module is conceived of in its entirety but is not released in its fully polished final form. This means we can get raw content out quickly while still doing polishing on the back end - like a [b]spiraling wave of lewd perfection[/b]. 

Raw content for a module has several core elements: a Mistress (or two), a script with subtitles, the game mechanics that support the script, and an environment. 

At the most basic level, with those things in place, players can play through the game and enjoy some delicious submission while being able to give us feedback on what will make the game even better. Because we are ambitious and want this game to be more than playable, but in fact gorgeous and immersive, we will be adding[b] layers[/b] of improvement over these core elements as we continue to evolve the game. In fact, think of our approach as a way for you to watch game development unfold in [b]real-time[/b]. 

Let me give you an example. We chose to release[b] Dominatrix Simulator: [i]Threshold[/i][/b] as a more fully complete module than just raw content in order to showcase what the game would ultimately be. The initial[b] layers[/b] we added to the core content included voice-over, music, ambient sounds, and ambient poses. Later, we added more[b] layers [/b]by putting in post-production lighting, a pose assistant, and a way for you to know if your “yes” or “no” response was being recognized. We will continue adding [b]layers[/b] such as lip sync, animations, and a custom environment.

Building and releasing the game in this way may make it feel like it will [i]never be finished[/i], but there is a method to our madness! Our goal is to keep producing content as long as we are being funded to do so and we don’t want to be unable to deliver something after you have supported us! So, we will always focus on the core content first, get that out, then polish and improve it over  time. If we can do both before releasing content, we will, but we won’t hold core content back if it’s ready to go!

More on upcoming content and a RELEASE DATE when I post again in a few days!

[b]Faster Content Creation[/b]

And on the subject of Patron funding!

Support for the project has risen dramatically in the last couple of months thanks to visibility on Steam and the broad range of places people can find us online (eg, Reddit, Milovana, VRPorn, GameVirt, etc), 

Thanks to the backing of our amazing Patrons and the willingness of so many fans to get involved, we now have a small team of people helping us produce content, providing feedback, or volunteering their time on the game’s development.  We are grateful for each and every one of them! This means we are moving through our content production pipeline so much faster! We are still getting into a rhythm as a group, but you can expect to see a lot more content in the near future! 

OUR TEAM

Devilish Domina	- Producer, writer, voice actor, game designer

If you want to volunteer to help, we welcome fan involvement! Message us here or on Discord to see what you can do!

notes.title: Approach to Content Release
notes.notes:
[b]Dominatrix Simulator[/b] is not just a game with a single Mistress or a single experience. This game is designed to bring you a house full of Mistresses, all with their own style, flare, and kinky preferences for you to submit to!

[b]Dominatrix Simulator: [i]Threshold[/i][/b] introduces you to the first, and ultimate Mistress, the [b]Goddess[/b]. But you aren't worthy of her, so you must be sent on to be instructred, trained, and groomed by the women filling her house.

The next release will be [b]Dominatrix Simulator:[i] Learning the Ropes[/i][/b]. The content will be rolled out in stages, rather than waiting for one big release at the end. This way, we can show you progress, use feedback to improve the game, and get content out as fast as we can create it. So, when we say 'release' we mean that we already have the characters, the story, and the game mechanics fleshed out for [b]Dominatrix Simulator: [i]Learning the Ropes[/i][/b], so when all of those ideas are full realized, the release will be complete.

Then we will move on to the next release phase with new content, characters, scenes, story, and features.

We hope you enjoy going on this journey with us as we flesh out this world of immersive submission and look forward to hearing your thoughts and ideas as we do!

Stay tuned for more updates on what is coming!
